description: This file defines the CustomerTransaction controller class for the OpenCart admin report extension, handling report display, saving settings, and generating transaction reports.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer transaction reports in OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the customer transaction report form with breadcrumbs and page setup.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings via POST request, with permission check.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer transaction report list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the customer transaction report list.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the customer transaction report list view with pagination and filters.
